column1: # Book 4 review (Fable, 2026-10-30). Finding 4.1190 accepted (animus = mind). Secondary 4.1088 accepted (totum adverbial: nature protests that it happens wholly the other way; Bailey, Munro). nervi = sinews at 4.1043 and 4.1115 (as at 4.536; not "nerves"). 4.1103, 4.1135, 4.1183 shortened to the band.

column2: gathering into fixed places in the sinews, and stirs
But nature protests that it happens wholly the other way;
nor with their hands rub anything off from the tender limbs
At last, when the desire gathered in the sinews has burst out,
either when the guilty mind perhaps gnaws at itself with remorse
and he would damn himself there for folly, having given her
and, if she is fair of mind and not hateful, in your turn
